question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Final query: top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories by highest composition value
WITH peak_composition AS (
    SELECT im.interest_id, im.month_year, im.composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY im.interest_id 
               ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC
           ) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_peaks AS (
    SELECT pc.interest_id, pc.month_year, pc.composition
    FROM peak_composition pc
    WHERE pc.rn = 1
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT rp.interest_id, rp.month_year, rp.composition
    FROM ranked_peaks rp
    ORDER BY rp.composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT rp.interest_id, rp.month_year, rp.composition
    FROM ranked_peaks rp
    ORDER BY rp.composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT t.month_year as time, im.interest_name, t.composition
FROM top10 t
JOIN interest_map im ON t.interest_id = CAST(im.id AS DOUBLE)
UNION ALL
SELECT b.month_year as time, im.interest_name, b.composition
FROM bottom10 b
JOIN interest_map im ON b.interest_id = CAST(im.id AS DOUBLE)
ORDER BY composition DESC
